memories.memory_text: I used the radio to call Marco urgently for help, shouting into it because I was desperate and knew I needed immediate assistance.

grounded_facts: Hellboy crashes through the ceiling and lands on one of the creatures, crushing it and interrupting the attack on Liz and Myers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy crash through the ceiling and land on one of the creatures, crushing it under the stone, which stopped the attack for a moment.

grounded_facts: Hellboy scoops up Myers and moves him to safety beside Liz.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hellboy scoop up Myers and move him to safety right beside me, putting us together where we could both stay protected.

grounded_facts: Two new Sammaels are born from glowing eggs, increasing their number to five.
memories.memory_text: I saw two glowing eggs transform right before my eyes, and suddenly there were two more Sammaels—five in total now.

grounded_facts: Multiple Sammaels overwhelm Hellboy, biting and knocking him to the ground, leaving him in critical condition.
memories.memory_text: I watched the Sammaels swarm Hellboy, biting and knocking him down until he was covered in blood and couldn't get up.

grounded_facts: Liz begs Myers to hit her, seeking to trigger her power through trauma.
memories.memory_text: I begged Myers to hit me because I knew I had to stop running from my power and finally face it.

grounded_facts: Frustrated by Myers' hesitation, Liz slaps him to force action.
memories.memory_text: I slapped Myers when he hesitated, needing him to act so I could trigger what had to come.

grounded_facts: Liz declares her love for Hellboy, marking an emotional turning point that precedes her power activation.
memories.memory_text: I realized and declared that I love Hellboy—I've always loved him—and in that moment, something inside me shifted.

grounded_facts: Myers finally hits Liz as she requested, triggering her power surge.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sting of Myers' slap across my face, the sharp pain I asked for, and I knew it was the trigger I needed.

grounded_facts: After being slapped by Myers, Liz unleashes a massive surge of fire that engulfs and destroys all the Sammael creatures.
memories.memory_text: After the slap, I unleashed a massive surge of fire from my arms that engulfed and destroyed all the creatures around me.

grounded_facts: A battle between Hellboy, Liz, Myers, and multiple Sammael creatures in an underground tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I was fighting alongside Hellboy and Myers against multiple Sammael creatures in an underground tunnel, trying to defend ourselves as they kept coming at us.

grounded_facts: Hellboy regains consciousness bound to a wooden yoke in a ceremonial chamber beneath a church, surrounded by occult machinery and figures.
memories.memory_text: I remember waking up chained to a wooden yoke in a vast chamber beneath a church, surrounded by statues, gears, and an eerie solar system model where an altar should be, with Grigory standing over me in ceremonial robes.

grounded_facts: Ilsa declares Hellboy to be the key and commands him to open the locks.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ilsa face Hellboy and declare that he was the key, the right hand of doom, and then command him to open the locks.

grounded_facts: Myers desperately warns Hellboy not to activate the portal.
memories.memory_text: I heard Myers shout desperately at Hellboy, begging him not to activate the portal.

grounded_facts: Grigory whispers to Liz, causing her to emit a plume of energy which he inhales; she then dies.
memories.memory_text: I felt Grigory lean over me and whisper something, and then I emitted a plume of energy that he inhaled before I died.

grounded_facts: Overcome with rage after Liz's death, Hellboy breaks one of his restraints and attacks Ilsa.
memories.memory_text: I remember seeing Hellboy struggle in rage after I died — he broke one of his cuffs and swatted Ilsa away, fighting to get free.

grounded_facts: A ceremonial event led by Grigory (Rasputin) to open the bottomless pit using Hellboy as the key during a lunar eclipse.
memories.memory_text: I recall Grigory leading a ritual during a lunar eclipse, invoking an angel with the key to the bottomless pit and demanding Hellboy open the door, offering my life and soul in exchange.

grounded_facts: Grigory proposes that Hellboy open the door in exchange for Liz's life, then her soul.
memories.memory_text: I remember Grigory standing over me, telling Hellboy to open the door in exchange for my life, then saying my soul was waiting on the other side if he wanted me back.

grounded_facts: After being told Liz's soul awaits on the other side, Hellboy consents to become the key and open the door.
memories.memory_text: I was told my soul was on the other side, and Hellboy heard the same—he must have known I was gone, but still chose to open the door for me.

grounded_facts: Grigory explains the power of names and reveals Hellboy's true name.
memories.memory_text: I remember lying at Grigory's feet as he spoke about the power of names, turning his back to Hellboy while facing the mural. I heard him say that names hold the power and nature of things, and he gave his own as an example—Rasputin, meaning 'The crossroads,' and how he had become that.

grounded_facts: Hellboy speaks his true name, Anung-un-Rama, initiating transformation into the key.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Hellboy speak his true name, Anung-un-Rama, and in that moment, I saw the transformation begin, as if he were becoming the key.

grounded_facts: Hellboy takes Liz's limp body in his arms and begins to move with her.
memories.memory_text: I felt Hellboy take my limp body in his arms and carry me away, his movements heavy with grief.

grounded_facts: Hellboy hands over Liz's body to Myers, instructing him to keep her safe while he confronts the unknown threat.
memories.memory_text: I remember Hellboy carefully handing my body over to Myers, though I couldn't move or speak.

grounded_facts: Hellboy gives a direct order to Myers to keep Liz safe no matter what.
memories.memory_text: I heard Hellboy tell Myers to keep me safe no matter what before he went ahead.

grounded_facts: Myers expresses concern by asking if Hellboy intends to face the threat alone.
memories.memory_text: I heard Myers ask Hellboy if he was going alone, his voice filled with concern.

grounded_facts: A large tentacle suddenly appears in the tunnel, smashes oil lamps onto Hellboy's head, and pulls him backward at high speed.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sudden rush and impact as a massive tentacle smashed through the tunnel, yanking Hellboy away.

grounded_facts: Hellboy cradles Liz's head and whispers lovingly to her, helping her return from death.
memories.memory_text: I felt Hellboy cradling my head against his chest, his hand gently holding me, and I sensed him looking at me with love as he caressed my hair.

grounded_facts: Hellboy whispers a powerful declaration of sacrifice to bring Liz back, stating he would die and cross over for her.
memories.memory_text: I heard Hellboy whisper that he would die and cross over for me, and that the other side would be sorry if they didn’t let me go — I learned then that he was offering his life for mine.

grounded_facts: Liz looks at Hellboy and sees him not just as a monster, but as the man she loves.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Hellboy and saw him not as a monster, but as the man I love.

grounded_facts: Liz regains consciousness after Hellboy's declaration, responding to his voice and beginning to perceive him as the man she loves.
memories.memory_text: I heard your voice in the dark — I'm not sure what you said, but it pulled me back.

grounded_facts: Myers smiles sadly and Manning watches as Hellboy and Liz reunite, both observing the emotional climax.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers smiling sadly and Manning watching as Hellboy and I came together, their quiet presence bearing witness to the moment that brought me back.

grounded_facts: A pivotal moment in the tunnel where Liz is brought back to life through Hellboy's declaration of love and sacrifice.
memories.memory_text: I opened my eyes and saw Hellboy for who he truly is — the man I love — and as we kissed, I felt my fire warm around us, bringing me fully back to life.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Liz share a kiss, symbolizing their love and completing her return to life, accompanied by rising fire and music.
memories.memory_text: I felt the warmth of Hellboy's lips on mine, our kiss sealing everything—our love, my return—as fire rose around us and music swelled in the air.

grounded_facts: Broom smiles and calls the infant Hellboy by name, marking a moment of affectionate recognition.
memories.memory_text: I remember Broom smiling at me and calling me Hellboy—it felt like the first time I truly had a name and someone who cared.

grounded_facts: Hellboy becomes the subject of widespread tabloid coverage, including sightings, conspiracy theories, and sensational TV segments, establishing his public mythos.
memories.memory_text: I saw how I started showing up in tabloids and on TV, with people talking about sightings and wild theories—I realized I was becoming a myth out there.

grounded_facts: Tom Manning voice-over expresses disbelief, calling the footage a costume and mocking public gullibility.
memories.memory_text: I heard Tom Manning’s voice dismissing the footage, saying it was just a costume and mocking those who believed—so I knew he didn’t see me as real.

grounded_facts: Broom sees the image of Hellboy on multiple television screens in an electronics store window, prompting an emotional reaction.
memories.memory_text: I saw my image on all those TV screens in the store window, and Broom was looking at me, calling me 'son' with that soft look in his eyes.

grounded_facts: Clay introduces Myers as Hellboy's new liaison in the den, marking a transition of responsibility.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Myers is my new liaison, assigned to me in the den, marking a change I didn't ask for.

grounded_facts: Hellboy explicitly states he does not want Myers as his new liaison, showing resistance to change.
memories.memory_text: I told Myers I don't want him as my new liaison.

grounded_facts: Following Clay's hint, Myers gives Hellboy the Baby Ruths, marking the first gesture of goodwill.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers offer me the Baby Ruths after coming into the light, and I remember how he recoiled at first — this was the first gesture of goodwill from him, following Clay's hint.

grounded_facts: Myers sees Hellboy for the first time in the flesh, realizing the supernatural being is real and physically imposing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers jump when I dropped the dumbbell, and I noticed him staring at my horn stumps—I realized he was seeing me for the first time and taking in what I really am.

grounded_facts: Hellboy notices Myers staring at his horn stumps and directly challenges him.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Myers staring at my horn stumps, so I called him out on it right away.

grounded_facts: Hellboy asks Myers for his first name, initiating personal engagement.
memories.memory_text: I asked Myers for his first name to start talking to him directly.

grounded_facts: An alarm sounds and red light blinks, indicating an operational shift or mission start.
memories.memory_text: I heard an alarm sound and saw a red light blink on the wall, so I knew it was time to move out.

grounded_facts: Hellboy comments on the ugliness of the crowd, highlighting the barrier between them and normal society.
memories.memory_text: I told Abe, 'Look at them ugly suckers, Blue. One sheet of glass between them and us,' because I could feel how separate we were from normal life.

grounded_facts: Abe responds to Hellboy's observation about the crowd with a reflection on his own life, emphasizing emotional and physical separation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe say 'Story of my life' after I commented on the crowd, and I knew he was feeling that separation too, in his own way.

grounded_facts: Hellboy expresses nostalgia and longing for being outside, hinting at a desire for normalcy and romantic connection.
memories.memory_text: I said, 'Outside. I could be outside --' because I was aching for something more, something normal, something free.

grounded_facts: A nighttime operation where the team is inside a modified garbage truck serving as a mobile crime lab, observing a crowd and preparing for action.
memories.memory_text: I was inside the modified garbage truck with the team during the nighttime operation, watching the crowd through the glass and feeling the distance between us and them.

grounded_facts: Hellboy retrieves a large, custom-built handgun from a steel box labeled 'The Good Samaritan' and prepares to use it.
memories.memory_text: I unlocked the steel box labeled 'The Good Samaritan' and took out my custom-built handgun, feeling its weight as I got ready to use it.

grounded_facts: Abe interprets Hellboy's nostalgia as a desire to reconnect with Liz, pointing out her absence directly.
memories.memory_text: I remember Abe telling me that I meant 'outside... with her,' interpreting my words as a desire to reconnect with Liz, like he could see right through me.

grounded_facts: Abe counters Hellboy's deflection by directly referencing Liz's departure and urging him to accept the reality of his situation.
memories.memory_text: I was told, 'Liz left us, Red. Take the hint,' and even though it hit hard, I wasn't ready to accept it just then.

grounded_facts: FBI/BPRD teams secure the courtyard and seal off the area by closing the gate.
memories.memory_text: I saw the agents closing the gate to seal off the courtyard as we prepared to move in.

grounded_facts: A coordinated operation entry by Red and Blue teams at the Machen Library loading dock.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that the Red and Blue teams were making a coordinated entry at the Machen Library loading dock based on Clay's order and our deployment from the truck.

grounded_facts: Clay instructs Hellboy and Abe to synchronize their locators.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Clay to synchronize my locator with Abe's.

grounded_facts: Clay, Abe, and Hellboy activate locator beacons on their belts to synchronize.
memories.memory_text: I activated the locator on my belt and saw it blink and beep along with Clay's and Abe's.

grounded_facts: The dumpster loader lowers, revealing Hellboy and Abe inside the garbage truck.
memories.memory_text: I was inside the garbage truck with Abe when Clay lowered the dumpster loader, and I saw the way out. I activated my belt light and started moving.

grounded_facts: Clay, Myers, Abe, and Hellboy enter the main lobby of Machen Library following a reported break-in and robbery.
memories.memory_text: I walked into the main lobby of the Machen Library with Clay, Myers, and Abe after hearing about a break-in.

grounded_facts: A BPRD team investigates the Machen Library after a break-in and robbery resulting in six guard deaths.
memories.memory_text: I figured we were investigating the Machen Library after a break-in and robbery that left six guards dead, based on what I saw and heard.

grounded_facts: Clay reports that an alarm was tripped at 1900 hours due to a break-in and robbery, with six guards found dead.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Clay that an alarm went off at 1900 hours because of a break-in and robbery, and that six guards were found dead.

grounded_facts: Broom reveals that not everything in the library was a fake, contradicting Hellboy's assumption.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Father that not everything in the library was a fake, which surprised me because I had assumed it all was.

grounded_facts: Hellboy expresses surprise upon seeing Broom, addressing him as 'Father'.
memories.memory_text: I was surprised to see Father there and called out to him, not expecting him.

grounded_facts: Hellboy sheepishly averts his gaze from Broom, indicating discomfort or guilt.
memories.memory_text: I felt uneasy under his gaze and had to look away, feeling sheepish about how I must have appeared to him.

grounded_facts: Broom explains the origin and true nature of the 16th-century statue, revealing it was a prison for a dangerous entity listed by the Vatican.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Broom that the 16th-century statue was more than just a relic—it was a prison for something dangerous, smuggled into the country and hollowed out to contain an entity the Vatican considered so threatening it ended up on the List of Avignon.

grounded_facts: Hellboy selects a clip and speed loader filled with specially crafted bullets containing holy water, silver shavings, and white oak.
memories.memory_text: I picked out a clip and speed loader with bullets I made myself—loaded with holy water, silver shavings, and white oak—because I knew I’d need something special to take down whatever was lurking out there.

grounded_facts: Abe uses his abilities to sense a malevolent presence behind the brass doors, identifying it as ancient, evil, and hungry.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe say there was a dark entity behind the door — evil, ancient, and hungry — and I knew we were walking into serious trouble.

grounded_facts: Hellboy opens the brass doors and steps into the illuminated room, initiating direct engagement with the unknown entity.
memories.memory_text: I opened the brass doors and stepped into the glowing room, ready to face whatever was in there.

grounded_facts: A nighttime disturbance at the Magik Exhibition Hall involving destruction, death, and the presence of a hostile creature.
memories.memory_text: I pieced it together from the remains on the floor—half-chewed boots, torn uniforms, and belts—along with the destruction all around and that awful sound above me; something had attacked the hall, killed people, and was still here feeding.

grounded_facts: Hellboy notices a large creature hanging from the ceiling, chewing on remains, and identifies the scene of destruction.
memories.memory_text: I moved through the wreckage under the blue emergency lights, startled by falling debris, and then I heard the sickening sound of bones snapping and chewing—my eyes followed the noise upward and I saw a huge pale creature hanging from the ceiling, feeding on something below.

grounded_facts: Hellboy mocks the creature Sammael for eating guards, belts, and boots, using dark humor to confront it.
memories.memory_text: I mocked that stinking creature Sammael, telling him the kitchen was closed and taunting him about eating six guards raw, belts and boots included, because he'd need heavy fiber to move that out.

grounded_facts: Abe communicates via earphone that he has discovered something significant.
memories.memory_text: I was told over the earpiece that Abe found something significant while I was confronting Sammael.

grounded_facts: Sammael's monstrous form is partially exposed, showing cracked, slimy white skin with blue veins, indicating his non-human nature.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sammael's neck split open, revealing pale, slimy skin cracked like old marble with blue veins pulsing underneath — he wasn't human at all.

grounded_facts: Hellboy tries to de-escalate the situation by proposing a peaceful resolution before resorting to violence.
Hellboy verbally attempts to negotiate a peaceful resolution with Sammael.
memories.memory_text: I tried to talk Sammael down, telling him we could work things out peacefully, even though I had 'The Samaritan' ready with big bullets just in case.

grounded_facts: Sammael violently twists his body 360 degrees and leaps away, rejecting any possibility of negotiation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sammael twist his body violently and leap away, making it clear he wasn't going to talk.

grounded_facts: Hellboy shoots Sammael with high-caliber ammunition, causing significant damage and ultimately bringing him down.
memories.memory_text: I opened fire on Sammael with my high-caliber weapon and brought him down after the shots hit him.

grounded_facts: Abe attempts to relay important information to Hellboy via earpiece, but is cut off.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe trying to tell me something urgent over the earpiece, but I cut him off before he could finish.

grounded_facts: Hellboy decides to ignore Abe's urgent message, indicating he considers the situation resolved.
memories.memory_text: I told Sammy it was over, turned away, and holstered my gun because I knew the threat was neutralized.

grounded_facts: The corpse that Hellboy was observing suddenly vanishes without explanation.
memories.memory_text: I was looking at the corpse, and then it was suddenly gone—I didn't see how it disappeared.

grounded_facts: Abe's voice recites ominous descriptions of the 'Hound of resurrection' from an unseen source, providing cryptic information to Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: I heard Abe's voice telling me about the 'Hound of resurrection'—something about it being a harbinger of pestilence and a seed of destruction.

grounded_facts: Hellboy interrupts Abe's recitation, urgently asking how to kill the creature.
memories.memory_text: I interrupted Abe, urgently asking him how to kill the creature.

grounded_facts: Sammael suddenly appears and violently strikes Hellboy, sending him crashing into the brass doors.
memories.memory_text: I didn't see Sammael coming—he just appeared and slammed me hard into the brass doors.

grounded_facts: Hellboy repeatedly impacts the library doors, causing them to bulge and crack under the force.
memories.memory_text: I kept slamming into the library doors, feeling them give way as they bulged and cracked under my force.

grounded_facts: Sammael launches a powerful physical attack on Hellboy, causing him to crash through multiple glass cabinets and fall through a window.
memories.memory_text: I was hit by a massive punch from Sammael, and I went crashing through six glass cabinets before falling through a window.

grounded_facts: Hellboy lands sideways in an industrial garbage bin after falling two stories, injured and struggling to stay conscious.
memories.memory_text: I landed hard in a garbage bin after falling two stories, and I could feel blood in my mouth while I fought to stay conscious.

grounded_facts: Grigory appears and claims to have brought Hellboy into the world, asserting exclusive knowledge of his true name and calling.
Grigory speaks to Hellboy with a tone of condescending familiarity, claiming a father-like role in his origin.
memories.memory_text: I heard Grigory speak to me with a condescending tone, calling me 'child' and claiming he brought me into the world, sang my first lullaby, and that only he knows my true name and calling.

grounded_facts: Grigory orders Sammael to discipline Hellboy for his lack of understanding of his place.
memories.memory_text: I heard Grigory tell me that he alone knows my true calling and true name, and then I heard him say I don't know my place before ordering Sammael to teach me.

grounded_facts: On Grigory's command, Sammael intercepts Hellboy and uses his prehensile tongue to bind and injure Hellboy's right arm.
memories.memory_text: I saw my gun on the ground and went for it, but Sammael landed in front of me and lashed out with his tongue—it wrapped around my right arm, squeezed, and pulled me down, and I could feel smoke rising from my skin as I writhed in pain.

grounded_facts: Hellboy dismisses Myers' attempt to help, asserting that no one ever helps him and that it's his job.
memories.memory_text: I told Myers no one ever helps me and that it's my job when he tried to step in and help me during the fight.

grounded_facts: Hellboy gives his gun and a fresh clip to Myers, instructing him to load a tracking bullet.
Hellboy gives Myers the gun and a tracking bullet, instructing him to load it.
memories.memory_text: I handed my gun and a fresh clip to Myers, then gave him a tracking bullet and told him to crack the pin and load it because I couldn't do it myself.

grounded_facts: Myers cracks the safety pin on the tracking bullet, causing it to activate with a glowing head, and prepares to load it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers crack the safety pin on the tracking bullet, and I watched the glass head start glowing like a chemical flare.

grounded_facts: Hellboy removes a black stinger from a gash in his arm and crushes it underfoot.
memories.memory_text: I pulled a black stinger out of the gash in my arm and crushed it under my foot, feeling it pop as I got back in the fight.

grounded_facts: A violent encounter between Hellboy, Myers, and Sammael's tongue in an alley behind Machen Library.
memories.memory_text: I was in the alley behind Machen Library, fighting Sammael's tongue with Myers when it came crashing through the steel, and I saw Myers firing at it while blood exploded in the air.

grounded_facts: Hellboy fires the activated tracking bullet from his gun, lodging it inside Sammael's tongue.
memories.memory_text: I stepped out and fired my gun repeatedly, shooting the activated tracking bullet into Sammael's tongue as it wrapped around the muzzle.

grounded_facts: Hellboy chases after Sammael as he flees over the wall.
memories.memory_text: I scrambled after Sammael as he fled over the wall.

grounded_facts: Myers calls out to Hellboy, urging him to stop and questioning his actions during the chase.
memories.memory_text: I heard Myers call out to me, yelling 'Wait! No, what are you doing?' as I was chasing Sammael.

grounded_facts: Sammael runs through the loading dock area, evading capture by Hellboy and using the environment to maintain distance.
memories.memory_text: I chased Sammael through the loading dock, but he dashed ahead and jumped onto a trailer, denting the roof before leaping into a crowded carnival.

grounded_facts: A crowded carnival area with a carousel, refreshment stand, and pumpkin patch, populated by vendors and trick-or-treaters.
memories.memory_text: I saw the carnival area with a carousel, a refreshment stand, and a pumpkin patch, full of vendors and trick-or-treaters.

grounded_facts: Workers express shock and alarm upon seeing Sammael, highlighting the abnormality of his appearance.
memories.memory_text: I heard workers react with shock when they saw Sammael, yelling things like 'What the hell is that??' and 'Whoa-whoa-whoa-' as he passed by.

grounded_facts: Hellboy notices a trail of glowing substance and begins following it at full speed, initiating pursuit of Sammael.
memories.memory_text: I noticed a trail of glowing goop and immediately started chasing it at full speed, jumping onto a driver's cab and crashing through an obstacle in pursuit of Sammael.

grounded_facts: Hellboy forcefully jumps onto the trailer and then the driver's cab, causing damage and endangering the driver, in order to maintain pursuit of Sammael.
memories.memory_text: I saw the glowing goop on the sidewalk and knew it was Sammael's trail, so I launched myself onto the trailer and then jumped onto the driver's cab to keep chasing him, crushing it under my weight—I didn't care if the driver screamed, I had to keep going.

grounded_facts: Sammael runs into the street, causing cars to swerve and avoid collision.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sammael bolt into the street and watched cars swerve to avoid hitting him as he landed on the other side.

grounded_facts: Hellboy uses his stone hand to stop an oncoming 4x4, preventing it from hitting him and Myers.
memories.memory_text: I saw the 4x4 speeding toward me and Myers, so I ran back, held out my stone hand, and stopped it dead to keep us from getting hit.

grounded_facts: A high-tension sequence involving Sammael and Hellboy running into traffic, resulting in a car crash and traffic jam.
memories.memory_text: I dove into traffic after Sammael, and when a 4x4 came speeding at me, I ran back, grabbed Myers, and stopped the vehicle with my stone hand—then it flipped over us, airbags exploded, and horns started blaring as traffic came to a halt.

grounded_facts: Hellboy confirms Myers is unharmed after the traffic incident.
memories.memory_text: I saw the 4x4 lurch toward Myers, so I ran back and stopped it with my stone hand, then I asked him if he was okay and he nodded.

grounded_facts: Hellboy verbally checks Myers' condition after the near-accident.
memories.memory_text: I asked Myers if he was okay after the near-accident, and he confirmed he was by nodding.

grounded_facts: After ensuring Myers is safe, Hellboy leaves to follow Sammael.
memories.memory_text: I made sure Myers was safe, told him to stay put, and then went after Sammael.

grounded_facts: Hellboy instructs Myers to remain in place while he pursues Sammael.
memories.memory_text: I told Myers to stay there while I went after Sammael.

grounded_facts: Hellboy follows the glowing goop into an adjacent alley, indicating pursuit of a target or clue.
memories.memory_text: I followed the glowing goop into an adjacent alley, chasing it as a lead toward Sammael.

grounded_facts: Hellboy observes that a metal grate has been moved, indicating recent passage.
memories.memory_text: I saw that a metal grate had been moved, and I realized someone—probably Sammael—had passed through recently.

grounded_facts: Hellboy enters through the opening by jumping in, indicating active progression into a new space.
memories.memory_text: I came up to the opening and jumped in, moving forward into the space beyond the grate.

grounded_facts: Hellboy lands on the subway track where Sammael is already seated, initiating their confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I landed on the subway track and saw Sammael just a few yards away, already seated.

grounded_facts: A direct encounter between Hellboy and Sammael in the tunnel, marked by tension and imminent violence.
memories.memory_text: I could feel the tension in the air between me and Sammael, like we were both ready to explode into violence at any second.

grounded_facts: Hellboy addresses Sammael mockingly upon arrival, attempting to assert dominance.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Sammael right when I got there, asking if he was waiting for me, just to get under his skin.

grounded_facts: Sammael sprints toward an oncoming train and prepares to attack it using a bone weapon.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sammael sprint toward the oncoming train and pull a long, scythe-like bone from his forearm before jumping at the front car.

grounded_facts: After being hit with the fire extinguisher, Hellboy disappears beneath the train.
memories.memory_text: I punched my stone hand through the steel floor and grabbed a handhold, pulling myself beneath the train.

grounded_facts: Hellboy uses his stone hand to punch through the steel floor of the train and secure a handhold, creating an entry point under the train.
memories.memory_text: I used my stone hand to punch through the steel floor of the train and grabbed a handhold to anchor myself underneath.

grounded_facts: The Train Driver strikes Hellboy on the head with a fire extinguisher while he is exposed beneath the train.
The Train Driver uses a fire extinguisher to strike Hellboy on the head.
memories.memory_text: I was exposed beneath the train when the driver started slamming me on the head with a fire extinguisher.

grounded_facts: Hellboy shouts that he is not an enemy during the attack.
Hellboy shouts to the Train Driver that he is not an enemy.

memories.memory_text: I saw the ruins of New York around me, charred and smoldering, with human remains everywhere and monstrous shapes moving in the distance under a blood-red sky.

grounded_facts: Hellboy undergoes a complete metamorphosis, displaying fully grown horns and fiery eyes and mouth, atop a mountain of skeletons in the ruined New York.
memories.memory_text: I felt my body change completely as I stood atop the mountain of skeletons, my horns growing fully, my eyes and mouth blazing with fire.

grounded_facts: Hellboy rejects the pigeon kid's suggestion to confess his feelings, citing the kid's age and the complexity of the situation.
The pigeon kid encourages Hellboy to express his feelings, but Hellboy dismisses the advice due to the kid's age.
memories.memory_text: I told the pigeon kid it's not that easy to confess how I feel, and that he's too young to be giving me advice.

grounded_facts: Two black B.P.R.D. sedans arrive abruptly, signaling an urgent situation.
memories.memory_text: I saw two black B.P.R.D. sedans arrive suddenly, rounding the corner fast.

grounded_facts: Agent Lime exits the vehicle and grabs Myers, speaking rapidly, indicating urgency or accusation.
memories.memory_text: I watched Agent Lime jump out of one sedan and grab Myers, talking to him fast and intense.

grounded_facts: Liz screams and covers her ears, likely in response to the sudden noise or tension.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz scream and cover her ears, reacting to the noise or the stress of the moment.

grounded_facts: Hellboy observes the sudden B.P.R.D. activity and concludes that something is wrong.
memories.memory_text: I realized something was wrong after seeing the sedans and the agents' behavior, so I snapped back into alert mode.

grounded_facts: Hellboy forcefully moves through the crowd of agents and Bureau employees gathered at Broom's office doorway, showing visible grief.
memories.memory_text: I pushed through the crowd at Broom's office, my face twisted with grief, because I had to get inside.

grounded_facts: Agents and Bureau employees are crowded in the doorway of Broom's office, indicating an urgent or significant situation.
memories.memory_text: I saw agents and Bureau employees crowded in the doorway of Broom's office, and I knew something serious had happened.

grounded_facts: A formal forensic team processes Broom's office after his death, collecting evidence under the supervision of Tom Manning.
memories.memory_text: I arrived and saw Manning with the forensic team already processing Broom's office.

grounded_facts: Professor Broom is found dead in his office, slumped in his chair with a pool of blood at his feet, marking a pivotal emotional and narrative turning point for Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: I saw my father slumped in his chair with blood at his feet, and I couldn't believe he was gone.

grounded_facts: Hellboy arrives too late and mourns Broom's death, expressing regret and emotional collapse upon seeing his father's body.
Hellboy expresses profound grief and regret to Broom's corpse, repeating that he has returned too late.
memories.memory_text: I held my father close and told him I was back, over and over, knowing I had returned too late and would never get to be with him again.

grounded_facts: Liz voices her worry about Hellboy's withdrawal and self-neglect following Broom's death.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz say I haven't spoken to anyone in three days, that I don't eat or sleep, and I know she's worried about me after Broom's death.

grounded_facts: The B.P.R.D. identifies the address 'Sebastian Plackba #16, Volokolamsk fields' as a lead in their investigation, marking a key development in the mission.
memories.memory_text: I was told that the B.P.R.D. had identified an address—Sebastian Plackba #16, Volokolamsk fields—as a lead in the investigation near Moscow.

grounded_facts: Manning asserts his authority over the upcoming mission, emphasizing his control and the finality of the operation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Manning say he'd be in charge of the mission this time and that he'd close everything down if we didn't finish it.

grounded_facts: A formal meeting held at the B.P.R.D. conference room where operational updates and plans are communicated.
memories.memory_text: I was in the B.P.R.D. conference room for a formal meeting where Manning gave us updates and laid out the plan for the mission.

grounded_facts: A private, emotionally charged conversation between Hellboy and Liz in Broom's office at dusk, following a moment of reflection.
memories.memory_text: I was standing in Broom's office at dusk, feeling pensive with my chest bandaged, and I noticed Liz watching me before we exchanged quiet hellos and she told me she'd come to Moscow.

grounded_facts: Liz informs Hellboy that she has changed her mind and will accompany him to Moscow.
Liz changes her mind and agrees to accompany Hellboy to Moscow if he is still going.
memories.memory_text: I remember Liz telling me she changed her mind and would come to Moscow with me, if I was still going.

grounded_facts: Hellboy acknowledges his insecurities about how Liz perceives him and expresses his commitment to their relationship despite his appearance.
Hellboy admits he understands Liz's discomfort with his appearance and reaffirms his unwavering commitment to her.
memories.memory_text: I acknowledged that I know Liz feels out of place because of what I am, and I told her I understand she might wish I could be different, like Myers, but I can't change how I look — still, I promised her I'll always look this good and I won't give up on her, ever.

grounded_facts: The team gathers on the cargo plane to review the threat of Sammael and prepare weapons and strategy for an upcoming confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The team gathers on the cargo plane to review the threat of Sammael and prepare weapons and strategy for an upcoming confrontation.

grounded_facts: Hellboy refuses to carry the Vulcan-65 grenade belts proposed by Manning, expressing distrust in their reliability.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy refuses to carry the Vulcan-65 grenade belts proposed by Manning, expressing distrust in their reliability.

grounded_facts: Hellboy interrupts and dismisses Manning's confidence in the Vulcan-65 grenades, stating they never work and refusing to carry one.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy interrupts and dismisses Manning's confidence in the Vulcan-65 grenades, stating they never work and refusing to carry one.

grounded_facts: Hellboy wraps Professor Broom's rosary around his wrist, symbolizing personal ritual or emotional grounding before combat.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Hellboy wraps Professor Broom's rosary around his wrist, symbolizing personal ritual or emotional grounding before combat.

grounded_facts: Hellboy questions who came up with the nickname 'Sparky', implying skepticism or amusement.
memories.memory_text: I questioned who came up with the nickname 'Sparky,' asking Myers with a hint of skepticism or amusement.

grounded_facts: The vehicle transporting Hellboy reaches its destination and stops; the cargo box is opened, indicating arrival at a new location.
memories.memory_text: I felt the box rattle and shake as we hit bumps, then I banged my head when the vehicle suddenly lurched to a halt—someone must have opened the cargo box, so I knew we'd arrived.

grounded_facts: Liz tells Hellboy to come out of the cargo box after arriving at the destination.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz tell me, 'Come out and see,' so I knew she wanted me to leave the cargo box after we arrived.

grounded_facts: Hellboy is prompted to leave the cargo box after arrival, marking a transition from confinement to active presence at the site.
memories.memory_text: I felt the crate stop moving and then the door opened; I knew it was time to come out and get into action at the site.

grounded_facts: Hellboy announces his intention to seek directions, suggesting an alternative to the group's plan.
memories.memory_text: I announced that I would ask for directions, offering a different approach than the group's current plan.

grounded_facts: Hellboy jumps into the open grave after lifting the broken stone cover.
memories.memory_text: I lifted the broken stone cover and jumped into the grave, moving from outside to inside.

grounded_facts: A gathering of characters around an open grave during the day.
memories.memory_text: I saw a group of people gathered around the open grave while I was getting ready to go in.

grounded_facts: The mummified corpse is temporarily reanimated through occult means after Hellboy places the amulet on its forehead.
memories.memory_text: I placed the amulet on the mummified corpse's forehead and saw it suddenly jerk to life, gasping and muttering in a dead language.

grounded_facts: Hellboy whispers an incantation and uses the amulet to initiate communication with the reanimated corpse, which responds by asking 'WHAT DO YOU WANT?'
memories.memory_text: I whispered the incantation and used the amulet to speak with the reanimated corpse, and I heard it ask me, 'WHAT DO YOU WANT?'

grounded_facts: Hellboy arrives at the Moscow Cemetery carrying the corpse of Ivan Klimentovich on his back, guiding the group toward a specific burial location.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at the Moscow Cemetery carrying Ivan Klimentovich's corpse on my back, guiding the group forward.

grounded_facts: The group arrives at a specific location in the Moscow Cemetery, guided by Hellboy and the animated corpse, to locate a particular grave.
memories.memory_text: I led the team further in, telling them we needed to go sixty feet ahead and three rows in to reach the right spot.

grounded_facts: The corpse of Ivan Klimentovich fidgets and weakly points in a specific direction, confirming the correct path to the grave.
memories.memory_text: I felt the corpse fidget on my back and saw its hand weakly point, as if confirming we were on the right path.

grounded_facts: Hellboy presents the corpse to the team, naming him as Ivan Klimentovich and prompting him to say 'hi'.
memories.memory_text: I introduced the corpse to the team, saying, 'This here is Ivan Klimentovich: Say "hi" Ivan.'

grounded_facts: The corpse speaks, giving a directional command to Hellboy, subtitled as 'GO THAT WAY, RED MONKEY'.
memories.memory_text: I heard the corpse mutter something, and I learned it said 'GO THAT WAY, RED MONKEY,' directing me where to go.

grounded_facts: Myers uses a crowbar to force open the ancient steel door of the Yefimovich Mausoleum, enabling entry.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers use a crowbar to force open the ancient steel door of the mausoleum, and then I walked in while carrying the desiccated abomination on my back.

grounded_facts: The group reaches the bottom of the staircase, arriving at an underground intersection with three branching corridors.
memories.memory_text: I saw that we reached the bottom of the staircase and arrived at an underground intersection with three branching corridors.

grounded_facts: Hellboy places the corpse on top of a pile of coffins.
memories.memory_text: I placed the corpse on top of a pile of coffins when we got to the intersection.

grounded_facts: Hellboy states that the group will be safe as long as they do not separate.
memories.memory_text: I told the group we'd be alright as long as we didn't separate.

grounded_facts: Spiked metal plates rise from the ground, blocking the exit and destroying the staircase, resulting in Stone's disappearance.
memories.memory_text: I saw spiked metal plates shoot up from the ground, blocking our exit and destroying the staircase—I watched Stone get hit and vanish in an instant.

grounded_facts: Hellboy instructs the team to turn on their locators, indicating heightened alert due to anticipated threat.
memories.memory_text: I told the team to turn on their locators because I knew someone was expecting us and we needed to stay alert.

grounded_facts: Liz calls 'Marco,' and Hellboy responds with 'Polo,' testing communication and presence.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz call 'Marco,' so I responded with 'Polo' to let her know I was here and that the radio was working.

grounded_facts: Myers questions the plan, seeking confidence from Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: Myers asked me if I was sure about the plan, looking to me for reassurance.

grounded_facts: Hellboy expresses low confidence in the situation but affirms Liz's capability to protect Myers.
memories.memory_text: I told Myers that on a scale of one to ten, my confidence was a two—but I made sure he knew Liz would take care of him because she's tough.

grounded_facts: Liz and Myers move off in one direction while Hellboy proceeds down the left tunnel with Agent Lime carrying the corpse.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz and Myers move off together while I headed down the left tunnel with Agent Lime, who was carrying the corpse.

grounded_facts: Hellboy gestures for silence when Manning speaks, attempting to maintain stealth and control in a dangerous situation.
memories.memory_text: I gestured for silence when Manning started speaking, trying to keep us both safe and maintain control of the situation.

grounded_facts: Manning insists on retreating and asserts his command over Hellboy, demanding they go back.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Manning that we should go back and that I could tear the door apart, asserting his command over me.

grounded_facts: Hellboy yanks Manning out of the way just before the pendulum strikes, saving his life.
memories.memory_text: I yanked Manning out of the way just in time, saving his life as that massive pendulum smashed down right where he was standing.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Manning attempt to cross a stone bridge in a vast chamber adorned with Slavic motifs, triggering a deadly trap.
memories.memory_text: I remember stepping onto the stone bridge in that vast chamber with Slavic carvings, hearing the loud clang as the trap triggered, yanking Manning to safety from the swinging pendulum, and barely rolling under the door as the bridge collapsed behind me.

grounded_facts: A series of mechanical pendulum attacks destroy the stone bridge, eliminating retreat and forcing Hellboy and Manning to advance into the hexagonal structure.
memories.memory_text: I was with Manning when we stepped onto the bridge and those giant pendulums started swinging, destroying it piece by piece—I barely made it across as the last section collapsed behind me.

grounded_facts: Hellboy narrowly avoids being killed by the final swing of the pendulum as the bridge collapses beneath him, successfully entering the hexagonal structure.
memories.memory_text: I barely made it across the collapsing bridge, running as chunks of stone broke apart under my feet, and rolled into the hexagonal structure just before the pendulum took out the last piece behind me.

grounded_facts: Kroenen is no longer present in the chamber, having left unnoticed.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Kroenen was no longer in the chamber, and I realized he must have slipped away without me seeing him.

grounded_facts: Hellboy voices annoyance at Kroenen's quick escape, comparing him to a cockroach.
memories.memory_text: I told Manning that this guy moves like a cockroach, annoyed at how fast Kroenen vanished.

grounded_facts: Hellboy readies his weapon and begins moving cautiously toward the lab after noticing Kroenen's disappearance.
memories.memory_text: I readied my gun and started creeping toward the lab, staying cautious after Kroenen disappeared.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Hellboy and Kroenen in the lab, triggered by an attack on Manning.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kroenen slash at Manning with his whirling blades and draw a long sword after I started blocking his attacks, turning the lab into a violent battlefield.

grounded_facts: Hellboy seizes Kroenen's sword and bends it irreparably, removing Kroenen's advantage.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kroenen pull out his sword, so I stepped in, used my stone fist to block, and then I yanked the blade from him and bent it like a twig to take away his advantage.

grounded_facts: Hellboy declares that Kroenen killed his father, transforming the fight into a personal mission.
memories.memory_text: I told Kroenen he killed my father, and I made it personal with every punch I threw at him.

grounded_facts: Hellboy intervenes to protect Manning from Kroenen's attack and begins fighting back with overwhelming force.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in to protect Manning when Kroenen attacked, using my stone fist to block his blades and fighting back with everything I had, punching him hard enough to crumple his mask and make him stagger until it finally fell off.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's repeated punches destroy Kroenen's mask, exposing his scarred face.
memories.memory_text: I punched Kroenen in the face over and over, crushing his steel mask with my fists until it finally fell off and I saw his scarred face underneath.

grounded_facts: Hellboy delivers a taunting threat to Kroenen after destroying his mask.
memories.memory_text: I told Kroenen to give his soul to God because I was claiming his body after smashing his mask.

grounded_facts: After being unmasked and beaten, Kroenen laughs mockingly at Hellboy.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kroenen laugh at me mockingly after I unmasked and beat him, even though he was barely able to breathe.

grounded_facts: A trapdoor opens beneath Hellboy and Manning, causing them to fall into a pit.
A sudden trapdoor causes Hellboy and Manning to fall into a blade-filled pit.
memories.memory_text: I was standing with Manning when the floor suddenly gave way beneath us, and we both fell into a pit filled with blades.

grounded_facts: Hellboy stops his fall by grabbing a rope with a knot that halts his descent.
Hellboy tries to grab Manning's hand during the fall.
Hellboy loses his backpack during the fall.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed the rope to stop my fall, and the knot in it jerked me to a halt—I reached for Manning's hand to try to save him, but I lost my backpack in the process.

grounded_facts: The phonograph crashes to the ground and is destroyed.
memories.memory_text: I fell through a trapdoor, and I saw the phonograph crash to the ground below me.

grounded_facts: Manning whispers that the fall wasn't that bad, despite the danger.
memories.memory_text: I heard Manning whisper to me that the fall wasn't that bad, even though it felt dangerous.

grounded_facts: The bottom of the pit is revealed to be covered in six-foot steel blades.
memories.memory_text: I looked down and saw that the bottom of the pit was covered in six-foot steel blades.

grounded_facts: Hellboy ascends by using the rope below him as a lasso, pulling himself upward hand over hand.
memories.memory_text: I used the rope below me as a lasso to pull myself up, hand over hand.

grounded_facts: Manning holds onto Hellboy's back while Hellboy climbs, relying on him for support during ascent.
memories.memory_text: I felt Manning clinging to my back as I climbed, relying on me to get us both up.

grounded_facts: Hellboy actively uses force to pull Kroenen into the spike pit, resulting in his severe injury or death.
memories.memory_text: I used my strength to pull Kroenen into the spike pit, and I felt the force of it as he went in.

grounded_facts: Hellboy uses the rope wrapped around his stone fist to yank Kroenen into the hexagonal trap door pit filled with spikes, causing him to impale and suffer fatal injuries.
memories.memory_text: I wrapped the rope around my stone fist and yanked Kroenen into the hexagonal pit, seeing him impale on the spikes and writhe as he screamed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy notices and takes possession of Kroenen's blade, which is embedded in the floor and still attached to the ticking prosthetic hand.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kroenen's blade stuck in the floor and took it, hand still attached and ticking.

grounded_facts: Kroenen frees one of his arms by cutting through his own bicep tissue after surviving the fall.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kroenen slice through his own bicep to free his arm after the fall.

grounded_facts: Hellboy mocks Kroenen for pretending to be dead, challenging him to stay dead.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Kroenen, calling him a Nazi pinhead who likes playing possum, and told him to try playing dead for real.

grounded_facts: Hellboy drops a massive cogwheel onto Kroenen, resulting in his apparent destruction.
memories.memory_text: I tipped the massive cogwheel over the edge and saw it crush Kroenen, hearing his horrid scream as he was destroyed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy asks Manning if he is okay, showing concern for his well-being.
memories.memory_text: I asked Manning if he was okay because I was worried about him.

grounded_facts: Hellboy decides to leave the current location to find an exit, promising to return for Manning.
memories.memory_text: I decided to leave and find a way out myself, telling Manning I'd come back for him.

grounded_facts: Manning criticizes Hellboy's method of lighting a cigar and demonstrates the proper way using a wooden match.
Manning criticizes Hellboy's cigar-lighting method and instructs him to use a wooden match, then demonstrates it.
memories.memory_text: I was lighting my cigar when Manning told me I was doing it wrong and handed me one of his fine cigars, then used a wooden match to light it for me, saying it preserves the flavor.

grounded_facts: Hellboy climbs a steep tunnel slope but finds no passage forward and collapses from exhaustion.
memories.memory_text: I struggled up a steep slope, grabbing rocks and roots to pull myself forward, but there was no way out—I hit a dead end and collapsed, completely out of breath.

grounded_facts: Liz uses the radio to call Marco for urgent help, signaling desperation and the need for external intervention.
Liz uses the radio to urgently call Marco for help.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Liz used the radio to urgently call Marco for help, yelling 'Marco, Marco, Marco... Get your Big Red butt over here!'—she was desperate and counting on me to come.

grounded_facts: Hellboy strikes the tunnel floor with his rock hand in a furious attempt to reach the kid.
memories.memory_text: I furiously pounded the tunnel floor with my rock hand, trying to break through to reach the kid.

grounded_facts: Hellboy crashes through the ceiling and lands on one of the creatures, crushing it and interrupting the attack on Liz and Myers.
memories.memory_text: I crashed through the ceiling and landed on one of those creatures, crushing it under me and a ton of rubble.

grounded_facts: Hellboy scoops up Myers and moves him to safety beside Liz.
memories.memory_text: I scooped up Myers and moved him to safety beside Liz so they'd be together and out of immediate danger.

grounded_facts: Two new Sammaels are born from glowing eggs, increasing their number to five.
memories.memory_text: I saw two glowing eggs suddenly transform, and just like that, two more Sammaels appeared — they multiplied right before my eyes.

grounded_facts: Multiple Sammaels overwhelm Hellboy, biting and knocking him to the ground, leaving him in critical condition.
memories.memory_text: I was swarmed by the new Sammaels — they jumped on me, biting and tearing — and I felt myself go down, blood covering my torso as I hit the ground.

grounded_facts: Liz begs Myers to hit her, seeking to trigger her power through trauma.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz, desperate and crying, beg Myers to hit her — she shouted at him, 'Hit me,' and said she'd spent her whole life running from her power but now wanted it to happen.

grounded_facts: Frustrated by Myers' hesitation, Liz slaps him to force action.
memories.memory_text: When Myers hesitated, I watched Liz slap him across the face to force him into action.

grounded_facts: Liz declares her love for Hellboy, marking an emotional turning point that precedes her power activation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz declare out loud that she loved me — she said, 'I love him. I've always loved him,' right before everything changed.

grounded_facts: Myers finally hits Liz as she requested, triggering her power surge.
memories.memory_text: After she slapped him, I saw Myers finally hit Liz hard across the face, and in that moment, her power surged.

grounded_facts: After being slapped by Myers, Liz unleashes a massive surge of fire that engulfs and destroys all the Sammael creatures.
memories.memory_text: I saw Liz unleash a massive firestorm that engulfed all the Sammael creatures — the flames consumed them completely, destroying every one.

grounded_facts: A battle between Hellboy, Liz, Myers, and multiple Sammael creatures in an underground tunnel.
memories.memory_text: I remember the fight in the tunnel—those Sammael creatures attacking Liz and Myers, jumping on me, biting, and the chaos as I tried to fight them off while bleeding and getting overwhelmed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy kills and partially consumes two Sammaels, leaving their remains half-cooked; other creatures are reduced to blackened bones.
memories.memory_text: I killed and partially ate the two Sammaels, and I pushed aside their half-cooked remains; everything else around me was reduced to blackened bones.

grounded_facts: Grigory silently laughs while observing Hellboy in the aftermath of battle, serving as a witness to the scene.
memories.memory_text: I turned weakly and saw Grigory laughing silently, watching me in the aftermath of the fight, a witness to the absurdity.

grounded_facts: Ilsa strikes Hellboy with a hammer in a sudden, brutal action.
memories.memory_text: I didn't see Ilsa coming, and then she hit me with a hammer in a sudden, brutal move.

grounded_facts: Ilsa declares Hellboy to be the key and commands him to open the locks.
memories.memory_text: I was told I am the key and commanded to open the locks, hearing 'You are the key! The right hand of doom!' and 'Open the locks.'

grounded_facts: Hellboy regains consciousness bound to a wooden yoke in a ceremonial chamber beneath a church, surrounded by occult machinery and figures.
memories.memory_text: I slowly came to, chained to a massive wooden yoke, and took in the strange church-like chamber around me—columns, gears, statues with swords, and an odd solar system model where an altar should be. I felt rage build as I tested the restraints, and then I looked at my huge right arm, really looked at it, like I was seeing it for the first time.

grounded_facts: Myers desperately warns Hellboy not to activate the portal.
memories.memory_text: I heard Myers desperately shout 'Don't do it!!' as a warning not to open the portal.

grounded_facts: Grigory whispers to Liz, causing her to emit a plume of energy which he inhales; she then dies.
memories.memory_text: I saw Grigory lean over Liz and whisper to her; then her body arched and a plume of energy came from her mouth, which he inhaled—and after that, she went limp and died.

grounded_facts: Ilsa actively destroys the timers on explosive belts, halting their countdown.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ilsa destroying the timers on the explosive belts with a hammer before I broke free and swatted her.

grounded_facts: Grigory proposes that Hellboy open the door in exchange for Liz's life, then her soul.
memories.memory_text: Grigory told me to open the door in exchange for Liz's life, then later said her soul awaits on the other side and I must open the door to claim her.

grounded_facts: A ceremonial event led by Grigory (Rasputin) to open the bottomless pit using Hellboy as the key during a lunar eclipse.
memories.memory_text: I saw Grigory standing before a mural of an angel with a key, holding his book open while Liz lay at his feet. I heard him quote about an angel with the key to the bottomless pit, and then he turned to me, demanding I open the door in exchange for her life—saying her soul was waiting on the other side if I would just claim her. I realized the eclipse above was progressing, and whatever he was doing was tied to it, with me as the key.

grounded_facts: Overcome with rage after Liz's death, Hellboy breaks one of his restraints and attacks Ilsa.
memories.memory_text: I was chained to a wooden yoke, struggling to make sense of everything when the grief over Liz hit me like a wave. I couldn't hold it back—I broke one of the cuffs and lashed out at Ilsa, swatting her away as she stumbled back. My heart was racing, my head pounding, and I kept fighting to free my other hand.

grounded_facts: After being told Liz's soul awaits on the other side, Hellboy consents to become the key and open the door.
memories.memory_text: I was told Liz's soul was waiting on the other side, and if I wanted her back, I had to open the door — so I agreed, for her.

grounded_facts: Myers is bound to a stone pillar above a blood channel leading to a mystical stone slab.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers bound to the stone pillar above a blood channel that led to the mystical slab, and I noticed my rosary had fallen near him after Grigory ripped it off my wrist.

grounded_facts: Grigory explains the power of names and reveals Hellboy's true name.
memories.memory_text: I heard Grigory say that names hold the power and nature of things, and then I was told my true name: Anung-un-Rama.

grounded_facts: Hellboy speaks his true name, Anung-un-Rama, initiating transformation into the key.
memories.memory_text: I spoke my true name, Anung-un-Rama, and felt the change begin within me.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's stone arm begins to glow, indicating activation of ancient power.
Flames briefly surround Hellboy's body, likely as a result of the stone arm's activation.
memories.memory_text: I felt my stone arm start to glow with ancient fire symbols, and then flames suddenly surrounded me.

grounded_facts: Hellboy undergoes a physical and supernatural transformation, manifesting horns and radiant energy, signifying his ascension to the Prince of Hell.
memories.memory_text: I roared as my horns burst forth, feeling the power surge through me as my shadow spread across the stone and turned it black.

grounded_facts: Myers desperately tries to stop Hellboy from activating the slab, expressing fear and opposition.
memories.memory_text: I heard Myers shouting at me, begging me not to do it, but I kept going.

grounded_facts: Hellboy inserts his paw into the first imprint on the stone slab and turns it, triggering a beam of crimson light.
memories.memory_text: I inserted my paw into the first imprint on the stone slab and turned it like a lock, triggering a beam of crimson light that shot into the sky.

grounded_facts: A burning glyph manifests after the first imprint vanishes.
memories.memory_text: I saw the first imprint vanish, and then a burning glyph appeared right after.

grounded_facts: Hellboy activates the second imprint by inserting his hand and turning it, causing a mechanical click.
memories.memory_text: I thrust my hand into the second imprint and turned it, hearing a mechanical click.

grounded_facts: Myers notices and reaches for the broken rosary, indicating intent to pick it up.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Myers seeing the broken rosary on the ground and starting to reach for it, so he must have wanted to pick it up.

grounded_facts: Myers shouts at Hellboy to remember who he is and throws him the rosary, triggering Hellboy's reclamation of self.
memories.memory_text: I was told to remember who I am when Myers shouted at me and threw me the rosary, which I caught and saw burn my hand before looking back at Grigory.

grounded_facts: Hellboy violently snaps off his own horns, releasing energy and using one to stab Grigory, marking a turning point in the confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed my horns and snapped them off, screaming as energy surged from the stumps, then I stabbed Grigory with one—his blood on it as he fell.

grounded_facts: Grigory attempts to open the final seal to fulfill Hellboy's apocalyptic destiny, but the ritual is interrupted.
memories.memory_text: I saw Grigory trying to force me to open the final seal to fulfill some apocalyptic destiny, but I resisted and stopped him by stabbing him with my broken horn.

grounded_facts: The final lock disappears into the stone, the moon connection breaks, and the eclipse ends, halting the ritual.
memories.memory_text: I saw the final lock vanish into the stone, felt the moon's pull break, and noticed the eclipse end—I think that's when the ritual stopped.

grounded_facts: Hellboy's stone hand stops burning, and his body returns to its usual appearance after the ritual is broken.
memories.memory_text: I felt my stone hand stop burning and my body shift back to normal as the glyphs faded and everything went quiet.

grounded_facts: Hellboy responds to Grigory's claim about destiny by stating he can live without fulfilling it, symbolizing his moral choice.
memories.memory_text: I told Grigory I can live without fulfilling his idea of destiny, because I choose who I am.

grounded_facts: Hellboy breaks Myers' chains and helps him up, signaling trust and alliance restoration.
memories.memory_text: I broke Myers' chains and helped him up, showing I still trust him and we're on the same side.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath following the failed ritual, where characters recover and the consequences unfold.
memories.memory_text: After everything settled, I felt my body return to normal and I broke Myers' chains to help him up.

grounded_facts: Hellboy takes Liz's limp body in his arms and begins to move with her.
memories.memory_text: I took Liz's limp body in my arms, kissed her forehead, and caressed her hair before walking down the steps, holding her close.

grounded_facts: Grigory, in his dying moments, tells Hellboy that though he killed him, he has unleashed a god.
Grigory, dying, confronts Hellboy and reveals that his death has summoned a powerful entity.
memories.memory_text: I turned to see Grigory on his knees, and he told me that though I killed him, I had unleashed a god by his death.

grounded_facts: A large, multi-tentacled entity erupts from Grigory's body and lands on a stone slab, beginning to grow rapidly.
memories.memory_text: I saw a large, multi-tentacled entity erupt from Grigory's body and land on the stone slab, covered in slimy steam, then start growing rapidly right before my eyes.

grounded_facts: Ilsa shows devotion by kissing Grigory's dead body before they are both crushed.
Ilsa kneels beside Grigory's corpse, kisses him, and is crushed along with his body by the emerging Behemoth.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ilsa kneel beside Grigory's body and kiss him—her way of saying goodbye—before the Behemoth rose up and crushed them both.

grounded_facts: Hellboy hands over Liz's body to Myers, instructing him to keep her safe while he confronts the unknown threat.
memories.memory_text: I carefully handed Liz's body over to Myers, making sure he had her as I prepared to face whatever was back there.

grounded_facts: Hellboy gives a direct order to Myers to keep Liz safe no matter what.
memories.memory_text: I looked Myers in the eye and told him, 'Keep her safe. No matter what. I'll deal with whatever's back there,' making it clear he had one job.

grounded_facts: Myers expresses concern by asking if Hellboy intends to face the threat alone.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Myers, 'Alone?' right after I gave him the order, as if he doubted I should go by myself.

grounded_facts: A large tentacle suddenly appears in the tunnel, smashes oil lamps onto Hellboy's head, and pulls him backward at high speed.
memories.memory_text: I saw a massive tentacle fill the tunnel and smash oil lamps onto my head before it yanked me backward at breakneck speed.

grounded_facts: Hellboy pulls a steel sword from a marble statue to fight the tentacle.
memories.memory_text: I pulled a steel sword from a marble statue to use against the tentacle that was attacking me.

grounded_facts: Hellboy uses the steel sword to sever the attacking tentacle.
memories.memory_text: I stood up and swung the sword with all my strength, cutting clean through the tentacle that was coming at me.

grounded_facts: The explosive belts are knocked into a deep crack and slide further down, becoming inaccessible.
memories.memory_text: I saw the explosive belts roll into a deep crack and slide out of reach.

grounded_facts: Hellboy uses his tail to grab the explosive belts just as he is being lifted by the tentacle.
At the last moment, Hellboy uses his tail to grab the explosive belts after being captured by a tentacle.
memories.memory_text: As the tentacle grabbed me, I used my tail to snatch the explosive belts at the last second and pulled them back to me.

grounded_facts: The timers on the explosive belts are crushed, rendering them non-functional.
memories.memory_text: I saw the timers on the explosive belts were crushed, so they were useless for normal detonation.

grounded_facts: Hellboy wraps the crushed but armed explosive belts around his stone arm to use them as a last-resort weapon.
Hellboy wraps the damaged explosive belts around his stone arm and pulls the pins, preparing to detonate them inside Behemoth.
memories.memory_text: I wrapped the damaged explosive belts around my stone arm and pulled the pins, arming them to blow inside Behemoth.

grounded_facts: Behemoth swallows Hellboy whole after raising him into its beak.
memories.memory_text: I was grabbed and swallowed whole by Behemoth after it raised me into its beak.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Hellboy and the creature Behemoth in an underground chamber.
memories.memory_text: I was in a brutal fight with Behemoth in an underground chamber, where a tentacle grabbed me and threw me around before I crashed into the floor, and later I saw its stump grow new wriggling tentacles after I cut one off, while a multi-layered mouth opened in its body and a strange gurgle came from inside it.

grounded_facts: Hellboy lands with great force after the battle with Behemoth.
memories.memory_text: I landed hard on the ground with a bone-crunching thud after the fight with Behemoth.

grounded_facts: Behemoth is destroyed in a chain reaction of explosions, leaving only cinders of flesh.
memories.memory_text: I saw Behemoth get caught in a chain reaction of explosions, consumed in fire and light, until only a few cinders of flesh were left floating in the air.

grounded_facts: Hellboy experiences pain from the final shockwaves of light passing over the ground.
memories.memory_text: I felt a sharp pain as the final shockwaves of light rippled over the ground, and I remember saying, 'Ouch -- It did hurt.'

grounded_facts: Myers smiles sadly and Manning watches as Hellboy and Liz reunite, both observing the emotional climax.
memories.memory_text: I saw Myers smile sadly and Manning watch us as Liz and I reunited, their eyes on me like I was something worth remembering.

grounded_facts: Liz regains consciousness after Hellboy's declaration, responding to his voice and beginning to perceive him as the man she loves.
Liz looks at Hellboy and sees him not just as a monster, but as the man she loves.
memories.memory_text: I heard Liz stir in the dark, and when she spoke, I knew she was coming back to me — then she looked at me not as some monster, but as the man she loves, and we kissed as fire rose around us.

grounded_facts: A pivotal moment in the tunnel where Liz is brought back to life through Hellboy's declaration of love and sacrifice.
Hellboy whispers a powerful declaration of sacrifice to bring Liz back, stating he would die and cross over for her.
Hellboy cradles Liz's head and whispers lovingly to her, helping her return from death.
memories.memory_text: I cradled Liz in my arms, whispering to her that I would die and cross over for her, begging the other side to let her go, and when she came back, I kissed her as fire rose around us.

grounded_facts: Hellboy and Liz share a kiss, symbolizing their love and completing her return to life, accompanied by rising fire and music.
memories.memory_text: I kissed Liz, feeling the fire rise around us as music swelled, knowing this was where I belonged.

memories.memory_text: I remember the warmth of the blanket and the sweet taste of candy in my mouth, the first thing I ever knew. Broom’s voice was soft, and he called me Hellboy.
I didn’t understand why they kept showing blurry images of me running through alleys, like some monster caught on film. People screamed about seeing me, marrying me—like I was a myth they made up.
I heard that voice—Grigory’s—and it hit me like a gut punch. He said he sang my first lullaby, that he brought me into this world. I couldn’t move, couldn’t think straight.

I saw my gun on the ground and went for it, but then Sammael dropped down. His tongue—thick as an arm, with pulsing yellow sacs—whipped out and wrapped around my right arm. I hit the ground hard, smoke rising from my skin as it squeezed.

I threw up my stone hand just in time to stop that 4x4 from flattening us—metal crunched, the damn thing flipped right over us. After the dust settled, I asked Myers if he was okay, and he just nodded, wide-eyed.
I shut off my locator and walked into the dark, knowing Myers was still talking—but I had to go it alone.
I sat next to her on that bench, told her Abe’s losing it, Father’s still mad at me — tried to get her to come back. When I said 'I --', she cut me off. Just 'No.'

I found a stack of old albums under a pile of kids' shoes—hundreds of sad orphan faces staring up, some of them cut out like someone tried to erase them. There was even a letter to Father Christmas from 1866, never sent.
I caught sight of Kroenen frozen in the tunnel light—just for a second—then he bolted. I didn't think, I just ran after him, gun in hand, shouting 'Son of a -- !'
She's laughing. That's it—I'm done. I grabbed three cookies and shoved them in my mouth like it'd fix something.
I'm standing on a mountain of bones, fire in my eyes and mouth, horns fully grown—this is what I was born to become, and there's no hiding from it now.
I pushed through the crowd at the doorway, bodies blocking me like they didn’t even recognize me, my face burning with something I couldn’t hold back.
I held him close, whispering 'I'm back' over and over, like that could fix anything.
I wasn't here when he needed me — he died alone, and I can't take that back.
I never had the guts before to say it — standing there with Liz watching me, I finally told her I understand why what I am makes her feel out of place.
I promised her I'd never give up on her — said it straight, with that line about still looking this good, and she said she liked that.
I told Manning those damn grenades wouldn't work—never do. I'd rather have Broom's rosary on my wrist than some shiny new toy with a timer.
I stood there, covered in mud, and told them I’d get directions—while Manning was already waving everyone back to the vans like we had all the time in the world.

I pressed the amulet to the corpse’s forehead and whispered the incantation—cold, rotten wood under my hand, then a violent jerk as it sucked in air. It spoke in mangled Russian, some guttural 'WHAT DO YOU WANT?' like I’d yanked it out of sleep, not death.
I yanked Manning back just as that damn pendulum smashed through the bridge—barely got him out of the way in time.
I was running like hell, but the bridge crumbled under me—felt it give way just as I rolled under that closing door.
I smashed his mask in with one punch, felt the stone fist crunch through steel and glass — he wasn't walking away from that.
After the mask fell, I told him he killed my father — then hit him again. I wanted him to hear it before I broke him.

I saw Liz's body arch and that plume of energy leave her—Grigory sucked it in like it was air. She went still. I screamed, but it didn't matter. I broke one cuff and swatted Ilsa aside, but I couldn't get free in time.
Grigory ripped my rosary off and told me my true name—Anung-un-Rama. I felt it pull something deep inside. I closed my eyes and said it, just to get her back. 'Anung-un-Rama.'
I roared as my horns tore through, power surging up from deep inside — I could feel the heat in my breath, the weight of the change.
I slammed my hand into the imprint and twisted — felt it click — then that red beam ripped into the sky.
I saw the first imprint vanish from my skin, and in its place, a burning glyph flared up—hot, bright, like it was seared into me with a brand.
I grabbed my horns and snapped them off—felt the energy tear out of me, but I didn't stop. I drove one straight into Grigory’s gut, and he went down, choking on his own prophecy.
After the light died and the sky went quiet, I told him I could live with never being his damn prince—then broke Myers' chains and pulled him up.
I held Liz in my arms, her body limp and cold, and I kissed her forehead before walking down the steps — the last thing I wanted was to leave her, but there was no time.
I told Myers to keep her safe—no matter what—before stepping into that tunnel. Then something huge answered me with a tentacle, smashing the lamps as it dragged me back.
I lunged into that crumbling crack, fingers just shy of the belts—had to use my tail to snag them last second before the beast yanked me up.
Timers were crushed, sparks flying—knew they were dead—but wrapped the belts around my stone arm anyway. Pulling the pins was gonna hurt, but it was the only play left.
I remember hitting the ground hard—like every bone in my body cracked at once—after blowing that thing to hell. The air was thick with smoke and the last bits of its flesh just... floating like ash.
